feature_bullets: 【Breathable & Quick Dry Fabric】This men's swimsuit is made of 95% polyester and 5% elastane. Machine washable, it is breathable and dries quickly, absorbent and effectively wicks away moisture for optimal comfort and a cool sensation during your outdoor activities. Its four-way stretch fabric quickly recovers its shape after stretching, resists deformation, tearing, and pilling, and remains durable even after numerous washes.

【UPF 50+ Sun Protection】This men's swimsuit offers professional UPF 50+ sun protection. It blocks over 98% of harmful UV rays, protecting your skin from damage caused by prolonged sun exposure during outdoor activities. Its sun protection effectiveness is stable and remains optimal even after several washes.

【Ergonomic Fit】This sun protection swimsuit features an ergonomic fit and flat seams to reduce friction during exercise. It provides a comfortable fit without tightening. It offers full freedom of movement for swimming and surfing, allowing for a wide range of arm motion and optimal comfort.

【Trendy Printed Design】This anti-UV men's swimsuit features an original print that stands out from classic models. Its vibrant colors are durable and light-resistant, for a striking and attractive look.

【Great for Many Occasions】This men's short sleeve swimsuit is suitable for various water sports. It is perfect for swimming, surfing, snorkeling, beach activities, sea fishing, water aerobics and much more. Ideal for everyday use or outdoor leisure, it is the perfect choice for optimal sun protection and a perfect gift for Father's Day or a birthday.
